snippet.title: DRAGON NEST: CLASSIC - THE NEW ERA OF LAGENDIA!
snippet.description:
The New Era of Lagendia Has Begun! ⚔️

Epic adventures are back in Dragon Nest: Classic! It’s time to sharpen your sword, prepare your magic, and prove who the true Adventurer is in this challenging world. Face fierce monsters, battle in intense PvP combat, and make new friends on your journey!
What Awaits You in Lagendia?

✅ Action-packed and strategic PvP battles!
✅ Challenging dungeons to test your skills!
✅ Iconic classes and skills that will bring back memories!
✅ A solid community ready to adventure together!

A new era has arrived, and Lagendia awaits you! Are you ready to return to the battlefield?

Don’t forget to Like, Subscribe, and turn on the notification bell so you don’t miss the latest updates!

Discord : https://discord.gg/dragonnestclassic
Pre-Registration : https://seaclassic.dragonnest.com/Events/PreRegister#/
🇵🇭 https://facebook.com/dragonnestclassicph
